### Who is Jason Zhu (jasonzhu.ai)?

**Jason Zhu** is a former AI algorithm engineer turned tech creator, independent developer, and content entrepreneur.[github.com](https://github.com/zhuyansen/jasonzhu.ai) Operating primarily under the handle **@GoSailGlobal** on platforms like X (Twitter), he focuses on:[www.xiaoyuzhoufm.com](https://www.xiaoyuzhoufm.com/podcast/6540c81e9cb67569a2f99856)
* **AI Application & Practice:** Publishing reviews, hands-on tutorials, and insights regarding global AI tools and workflows.[jasonzhu.ai](https://jasonzhu.ai/en)
* **"Go Global" (出海) Growth:** Helping creators and developers understand how to build, market, and scale technical products and personal brands internationally. 
* **Content & Communities:** Managing his personal platform **jasonzhu.ai**, which functions as a hub for AI tool databases, prompt engineering handbooks, tutorials, and indie-hacker documentation.

---

### What does GoSail Club do?

**GoSail Club** (frequently associated with his "GoSail" ecosystem, which includes *GoSail Lab* and *Ship2Market*) acts as an initiative, studio, or community tied to his overseas growth and AI marketing operations. Specifically, it serves as:
* **An AI Product & Marketing Lab:** Focusing on helping developers and tech creators take their AI applications to international markets ("going global").[ship2market.ai](https://ship2market.ai/en/)
* **Growth and Go-To-Market Support:** Offering resources, marketing insights, and validation tactics (such as tracking verified demand and new digital products) for independent builders.
